segments.sn10.2:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati gijjhakūṭe pabbate.
segments.sn10.2:1.2: Atha kho sakkanāmako yakkho yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi –
segments.sn10.2:2.3: Samaṇassa na taṃ sādhu, yadaññamanusāsasī”ti [yadaññamanusāsatīti (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)].
segments.sn10.2:3.3: Na taṃ arahati sappañño, manasā anukampituṃ.
segments.sn10.2:4.3: Na tena hoti saṃyutto, yānukampā [sānukampā (sī. pī.)] anuddayā”ti.

lines: Dutiye sakkanāmakoti evaṃ nāmako eko yakkho, so kira mārapakkhikayakkho.
Yadaññanti ettha yanti kiriyāparāmasanaṃ, tasmā yaṃ aññassa anusāsanaṃ, taṃ samaṇassa na sādhūti yojanā.
Taṃ kāraṇantaraṃ samāgataṃ purisaṃ sappañño sambuddho anukampituṃ nārahati visesādhigamābhāvā, sati pana tasmiṃ savisesaṃ pasādo hotīti.
Manasā ce … pe … na tena hoti saṃyutto sinehavasena anukampā anuddayā tassā asaṃkiliṭṭhasabhāvattā.
